en: Colorized postcard showing an ornate proscenium stage with columns, drapery, chandeliers and decorative vases. Within the frame is a miniature marionette theater scene: a small puppet figure stands beside a bicycle before a painted backdrop of a winding road leading to a castle-like structure and a wooded landscape. German text is printed in red at the bottom margin, with publisher information in smaller type.
